title: Order priority by customer
subtitle: When enabled, orders from assigned customers automatically receive the corresponding priority at import time (manual and automatic) — only applied when the order has no priority yet, never overrides manual edits, and does not backfill running orders. Customers in the "Unassigned" column → normal orders. Each customer belongs to only 1 level — drag & drop then click Save.
leaveConfirm: You have UNSAVED priority assignment changes. Leaving will discard them — continue anyway?
